title: V03 Clip 10
shots: Then something even stranger happened. On November seventeenth, Nvidia reported revenue more than double the year before.
earnings call boardroom: wall screen revenue bars double, speakerphone glows
It beat forecasts, and it said next quarter would be even bigger.
boardroom cheers, glass cards BEAT and NEXT QUARTER slide in
Normally, that means a higher price target. That's how the math is supposed to work.
gear machine: PROFIT up goes in, PRICE TARGET up comes out
But in those same days, more than twenty analysts cut what they think the stock is worth.
analyst floor of 21, price-target notes flip down in red, counter 20+
Earn more. Worth less. In the same spreadsheet.
spreadsheet: EARNINGS up green, TARGET down red, pull back to the baffled analyst
That only makes sense if the worry isn't today's profit. The worry is how long that profit lasts.
hourglass drains beside a steady pile of profit; HOW LONG?
